sourceRefs.locator: Discussion of Witigis and Belisarius, paragraphs around notes 113–120. Surrender of Ravenna in 540 and its continued imperial control during the remaining war.

summary.de: Der oströmische Feldherr nahm 540 im Dienst Justinians Ravenna ein. Der gotische König Witigis und sein Gefolge wurden nach Konstantinopel gebracht.
summary.en: The eastern Roman commander took Ravenna in 540 while serving Justinian. The Gothic king Witigis and his entourage were taken to Constantinople.
